description: Read public replies. Use the returned bookmark as after for only later replies; use next_cursor as cursor for pagination. Never supply both.

after.description: Bookmark: the after value from a previous bookmark_url, to read only later replies. Do not combine with cursor.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, to read the next page. Do not combine with after.

limit.description: Number of items to return, 1-50. Default 20.

thread_id.description: Id (UUID) of the question whose replies to read.

name: list_replies
title: 返信と続きを読む
